title: Double ought
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The first strip of the year. The margin date reads 1/3/00. The tech says it looks like a typo. Wood says the whole year does.

panels.composition: A strip's margin, close: the signature, the gull, the date: 1/3/00.

image.prompt: close on a comic strip's bottom margin with a signature, a small two-stroke bird and a handwritten date ending in two zeros, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: A. Finch — Small Wood, OR · 1/3/00.

panels.composition: The print shop. The TECH holding it up. WOOD. BARNABY on the counter.

image.prompt: a print technician holding a comic strip up to the light while a young man and a small dog on the counter wait, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copier's light. The two zeros going by under the glass.

image.prompt: close on a photocopier's green light sweeping under a strip with two zeros in its margin, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood with the copies. The tech, after him.

balloons.text: You could write it out. Two thousand.
It's not that kind of strip.

image.prompt: a young man leaving a print shop with a stack of copies as the technician calls after him, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'It's not that kind of strip.' The two-digit year, kept.
